test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate theme of the passage.

options.text: The significance of seeking professional advice
The need for evidence-based decision making
The influence of personal experiences on our beliefs
The role of scientific evidence in debunking misconceptions

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses how personal experiences and **the influences from family, society, and books shape our** **preconceived(पूर्वग्रही)** notions. (Paragraph 2)
 
• ​The author's **anecdote** (उपाख्यान,कि़स्‍सा चुटकला, लतीफ़ा)** **about their grandson and the ice cream highlights how personal experiences impact our beliefs. (Paragraph 3)

**Therefore, the correct answer is "The influence of personal experiences on our beliefs".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option (1)** is not directly addressed in the passage.
 
• **Option (2) **is a minor aspect relative to the broader theme of personal experiences.
 
• **Option (4)** is illustrated by an anecdote but is not the central theme of the passage.
